content: Providers in India include global hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP via Mumbai/Hyderabad regions) and specialized local providers (E2E Networks, Yotta Shakti Cloud, Cyfuture Cloud, NeevCloud) offering modern NVIDIA GPUs like H100, Blackwell Ultra, L4, A100 with INR billing and local support.
source: E2E Networks, Bloomberg, New Indian Express

content: AWS (Mumbai), Google Cloud (Mumbai, Delhi), Microsoft Azure (Mumbai, Pune, Chennai), IBM Cloud (Delhi), Oracle Cloud (Hyderabad), Alibaba Cloud (Hyderabad), Tata Communications, Reliance Jio, CtrlS, Netmagic (NTT).
